d:
Two more suspicious explosive devices have been found near Ramsinghpur Railway Station in Rajasthan's Sri Ganganagar district.
The objects were reportedly recovered following information provided by the two accused, Mahakdeep Kaur and Devinder Singh, arrested in connection with the November 3 railway track blast. According to initial reports, one device was found intact while the other was damaged.
Police are investigating the alleged links of the accused with Pakistan-based handlers identified as Shah and Chacha.
